_comment: PR path recognition rules. Each category uses a glob array to describe its match condition; matching any glob counts as a hit for the category. Glob subset: ** matches any characters (including /), * matches non-/ characters within a segment, ? matches a single non-/ character. Any other character is treated as a literal (auto-escaped). Matches are always anchored to the full path (equivalent to ^...$). {a,b}, [abc] and ! negation are not supported.
_output_semantics: Outputs come in two flavors: (1) NEED_*_TEST_TIA indicates test/source changes; downstream can rely on TIA (Test Impact Analysis) for incremental runs. (2) NEED_*_TEST_FULL indicates build/dependency configuration changes; the TIA baseline is no longer trustworthy so downstream should drop incremental mode and run the full suite. When both are true, FULL takes precedence (full ⊇ incremental). NEED_*_SA signals that the corresponding static analysis should be re-run.
